author: Andrew Fisher
findings: Opening keeps the entire circuit visible in both aspects. At 4.8 s the real simulation contains 218 smoke particles but the default product overview remains clear.
At 9 s the product road camera shows the car clearly, with no residual smoke particles.

At 20.533 s approximately 0.77 km the real drift emits 41 smoke particles; both captures keep the car body readable with smoke trailing behind. No opacity/particle change is justified by these actual product views.
Desktop and phone seam banners now show a clean gap without overlapped artwork. Driver views remain unobstructed, and the ordinary progress map updates along the real frame loop.
limits: Real frame simulation with intermediate GPU draws suppressed proves deterministic presentation state, not real-device frame rate or temporal smoothness.
Anti-aliasing capability correction and actual Detail/Front detail UI captures are separate pending gates.
